sentences.en: Little by little, you will notice improvement in your writings.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，你会注意到你的写作有所改进。

sentences.en: Now that I notice it, I have nowhere to run.
sentences.zh: 既然我已经注意到了这一点，我就无处可逃了。

sentences.en: It'll be impossible to get a visa at short notice.
sentences.zh: 如果临时通知的话，就不可能拿到签证了。
